evidenceSummary: Live GitHub inventory plus security scans, builds, tests, and governance validation across all 23 local dev-branch checkouts.

repositories.name: .github
repositories.status: Hardened organization governance and generated portfolio controls on dev, with 30 local tests and live inventory validation passing.
repositories.next: Resolve GitHub Actions billing, choose the private-branch protection path, and explicitly approve promotion of the reviewed governance baseline to main.
repositories.concern: Hosted Actions are blocked by the account spending limit; private-repository branch protection is unavailable on the current plan, and dev-only community files are not yet organization defaults.

repositories.name: Almanac
repositories.focus: Private tasting notes for wine, whiskey, coffee, and cigars.
repositories.status: Encrypted local-first Flutter release candidate with enrollment-bound device lock, native screen privacy, 48 passing tests, and mobile build checks.
repositories.launchEvidence: Encrypted local vault, enrollment-bound device authentication, native backup and screen-privacy controls, automated tests, and Android/iOS release-build checks.
repositories.next: Choose and implement full-vault recovery, then complete physical-device, purchase, accessibility, and store QA.
repositories.concern: Full-vault recovery is not implemented; client-side entitlement checks remain a soft commercial gate, and biometric enrollment changes still need hardware validation.

repositories.name: Apiary
repositories.focus: Offline iPhone beekeeping logbook with encrypted records and backups.
repositories.status: Offline-first iPhone release candidate with encrypted SQLite, fail-closed app lock, native capture/app-switcher privacy, and 58 passing tests.
repositories.launchEvidence: Encrypted offline records, exports and backups, hardened lifecycle locking, native privacy controls, automated tests, and iOS release-build validation.
repositories.next: Run Face ID/passcode, screen-capture, physical-device, and accessibility QA, then configure App Store signing and the purchase product.
repositories.concern: The local trial can reset after reinstall and must remain explicit; individual screenshots cannot be blocked on iOS, and release still needs owner legal approval.

repositories.name: App-Template
repositories.status: Security-reviewed Flutter scaffold for local-only, local-first, and Supabase-backed products, tagged template-baseline-2026-09-14 with template mode enabled.
repositories.next: Explicitly approve dev-to-main promotion of the hardened baseline, then verify a generated repository from the template.
repositories.concern: GitHub generates templates from stale default branch main until promotion; provider-backed modes still require per-product security review.

repositories.name: Bivy
repositories.focus: Camping and RV trip log with site notes and recap exports.
repositories.status: Concept-only repository with implementation-readiness guardrails and automated governance validation on dev.
repositories.next: Define the trip and campsite schema plus recap-export requirements, then scaffold from App-Template with product CI.
repositories.concern: No application implementation or product tests and build checks exist.

repositories.name: Chat-Armor
repositories.focus: Family-safety concept pending platform, consent, privacy, and legal feasibility review.
repositories.status: Research-only repository with implementation-readiness guardrails and automated governance validation on dev.
repositories.next: Resolve platform feasibility, consent, and the privacy model before scaffolding.
repositories.concern: The concept involves highly sensitive child and message data; beta-style claims must not imply an implemented product.

repositories.name: Convoy
repositories.focus: PCS and household move inventory with claim-ready exports.
repositories.status: Concept-only repository with implementation-readiness guardrails and automated governance validation on dev.
repositories.next: Define the evidence and claim-export model, then scaffold from App-Template with product CI.
repositories.concern: No application implementation or product tests and build checks exist.

repositories.name: Cradle
repositories.focus: Feedings, diapers, sleep, growth, and milestone tracking.
repositories.status: Concept-only repository with implementation-readiness guardrails and automated governance validation on dev.
repositories.next: Define the event model and caregiver-sharing boundary before scaffolding.
repositories.concern: The product would handle sensitive child data; sharing and recovery remain unresolved.

repositories.name: Deep-Six
repositories.focus: Scuba logbook with sites, buddies, and certification-ready records.
repositories.status: Concept-only repository with implementation-readiness guardrails and automated governance validation on dev.
repositories.next: Define the dive and certification schema plus export requirements, then scaffold from App-Template with product CI.
repositories.concern: No application implementation or product tests and build checks exist.

repositories.name: Hook
repositories.focus: Fishing journal with private catches, photos, and encrypted spot records.
repositories.status: Concept-only repository with implementation-readiness guardrails and automated governance validation on dev.
repositories.next: Define encrypted photo and location storage plus recovery, then scaffold with CI.
repositories.concern: Sensitive location data and device-loss recovery behavior remain unresolved.

repositories.name: Majestic-Made-Hub
repositories.status: Next.js portfolio and waitlist site pinned to Node 24, with guarded concept claims, 29 passing tests, a production build, and zero dev-branch audit findings.
repositories.next: Choose RoomProof and proposed-price visibility, select production waitlist abuse controls, complete owner/legal review, and explicitly approve dev-to-main promotion.
repositories.concern: Default main remains stale with 29 Dependabot alerts; hosted Actions are billing-blocked, and Supabase waitlists add retention, deletion, and abuse-control obligations.

repositories.name: Paws
repositories.focus: Pet health records, medications, incidents, and vet-ready exports.
repositories.status: Encrypted local-vault Flutter release candidate with enrollment-bound device lock, native backup/screen privacy, on-device PDF reports, and mobile build checks.
repositories.launchEvidence: Encrypted local vault, device-bound authentication, native data protections, automated tests, PDF validation, and Android/iOS release builds.
repositories.next: Resolve the trademark/name and recovery decisions, then run biometric hardware, physical-device, accessibility, purchase, and store QA.
repositories.concern: Full-vault recovery is not implemented, biometric enrollment changes need hardware validation, and copy must remain recordkeeping rather than veterinary advice.

repositories.name: Range
repositories.focus: Firearm registry, range log, ammo inventory, and license vault.
repositories.status: Concept-only repository with implementation-readiness guardrails and automated governance validation on dev.
repositories.next: Define the MVP and security architecture before scaffolding.
repositories.concern: The proposed firearm and license data is particularly sensitive; no implementation or product validation exists.

repositories.name: ReachMe
repositories.focus: Local contact wallet, QR sharing, and optional expiring public links.
repositories.status: Flutter contact wallet plus Cloudflare worker and PWA release candidate with stale-auth rejection, native screen privacy, and aligned iOS target versions.
repositories.launchEvidence: Local contact wallet, explicit-field publishing, Cloudflare link service, PWA, 22 Flutter tests, four native tests, and iOS release-build validation.
repositories.next: Configure a Cloudflare staging environment and Cron, then run hosted-link abuse, expiry, revoke, recovery, and physical-device tests.
repositories.concern: Published fields are public; D1 creates recurring security, retention, and cost obligations, while provider credentials and deployed staging require owner access.

repositories.name: RideBinder
repositories.focus: Motorcycle maintenance, documents, receipts, reminders, and resale history.
repositories.status: Local-first Flutter release candidate with hardened biometric credential storage, native screen privacy, optional cloud modules, and 260 passing tests.
repositories.launchEvidence: Local-first records, encrypted backups, API-28 strong-biometric enforcement, stale-key cleanup, 260 tests, Android/iOS builds, and API-30/API-36 runtime smoke checks.
repositories.next: Run biometric hardware and physical-device QA, then configure production HTTPS callbacks and App/Universal Links before enabling cloud flags.
repositories.concern: Optional sync, storage, sharing, and AI extraction expand cost/security scope; real-device biometric enrollment-change behavior remains unverified.

repositories.name: RoomProof
repositories.focus: Before/after cleaning reports with photos, checklists, issues, signatures, and PDFs.
repositories.status: Concept-only repository with implementation-readiness guardrails and automated governance validation on dev.
repositories.next: Define photo, signature, time, and location retention, then scaffold Flutter from App-Template with product CI.
repositories.concern: Evidence media and location metadata need an explicit privacy and deletion model before implementation.

repositories.name: RoutineCue
repositories.focus: Child routines, chores, approvals, points, rewards, and optional allowance tracking.
repositories.status: Flutter/Supabase collaborative release candidate with hardened backend policies, current local SMTP config, 12 passing database checks, and mobile build validation.
repositories.launchEvidence: Mobile workflows, reviewed Supabase authorization and retention logic, automated app/backend tests, local database validation, and Android/iOS release builds.
repositories.next: Apply the reviewed backend to a non-production Supabase project, configure purchases/notifications, and run multi-device family QA.
repositories.concern: Child data and photo proof require high-trust cloud operations; staging credentials, push providers, retention operations, and cost alerts require owner-controlled services.

repositories.name: Steward
repositories.focus: Home inventory for insurance and household records.
repositories.status: Concept-only repository with implementation-readiness guardrails and automated governance validation on dev.
repositories.next: Specify encryption, export, and recovery before scaffolding.
repositories.concern: Insurance and home data is sensitive; cloudless device-loss behavior remains unresolved.

repositories.name: Trove
repositories.focus: Collector registry for coins, stamps, cards, watches, and militaria.
repositories.status: Concept-only repository with implementation-readiness guardrails and automated governance validation on dev.
repositories.next: Define the schema plus import, export, and recovery, then scaffold from App-Template with product CI.
repositories.concern: No application implementation or product validation exists; portability and recovery are undefined.

repositories.name: Use-By
repositories.focus: Pantry, fridge, freezer, and counter expiration tracking.
repositories.status: Encrypted local-inventory Flutter release candidate with enrollment-bound device lock, native screen privacy, CSV export, and 41 passing tests.
repositories.launchEvidence: Encrypted single-device inventory, device-bound authentication, native privacy controls, automated export tests, and signed Android/unsigned iOS release builds.
repositories.next: Choose recovery behavior, validate date/time-zone and food-safety copy, then run biometric hardware, physical-device, purchase, and store QA.
repositories.concern: Suggested dates are not food-safety advice; full-vault recovery is absent, and biometric enrollment changes need hardware validation.

repositories.name: app-legal
repositories.status: Public legal/support site with eight active product drafts, explicit non-production concept placeholders, and 15 passing safety/structure tests.
repositories.next: Have both founders and qualified counsel review the pages against final binaries and store disclosures.
repositories.concern: Automated checks can verify completeness and consistency, but cannot establish legal adequacy.

repositories.name: wolfe-server-apps
repositories.status: Security-reviewed Docker/Next.js deployment template with pinned Node image, secret-safe build context, container confinement, and passing validation.
repositories.next: Keep deferred until a server-backed product has an approved deployment need.
repositories.concern: This is infrastructure scaffolding, not a deployed service; a private Caddy hostname is not a network access-control boundary without Tailnet ACLs.

repositories.name: wolfe-server-infra
repositories.status: Substantial server hardening, deployment, monitoring, and backup-readiness automation with CI.
repositories.next: Configure scheduled off-site backups on the target host and complete a documented restore drill.
repositories.concern: Production readiness still depends on host-specific configuration, credentials, alert delivery, and a successful restore test.
